rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone acts casually as though nothing is wrong or important.

example.english: They ate nonchalantly despite hearing such serious news.
example.traditional: 佢聽到咁大件事，都仲係若無其事咁食飯。
example.jyutping: keoi5 teng1 dou3 gam3 daai6 gin6 si6 dou1 zung6 hai6 joek6 mou4 kei4 si6 gam3 sik6 faan6

rows.jyutping: m4 dong1 jat1 wui4 si6 gam3
rows.note: Use this when the nonchalant attitude specifically shows that the person does not regard something as important.

example.english: They kept singing nonchalantly after being scolded, as if it were no big deal.
example.traditional: 佢畀人鬧完都唔當一回事咁，仲喺度唱歌。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bei2 jan4 naau6 jyun4 dou1 m4 dong1 jat1 wui4 si6 gam3 zung6 hai2 dou6 coeng3 go1

rows.note: Use this when the nonchalant manner is mainly shown by acting calmly and without rushing.

example.english: Everyone else was rushing to hand in the assignment, but they wrote nonchalantly and took their time.
example.traditional: 大家都趕住交功課，得佢唔慌唔忙咁慢慢寫。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 dou1 gon2 zyu6 gaau1 gung1 fo3 dak1 keoi5 m4 fong1 m4 mong4 gam3 maan6 maan2 se2
